name: TDD Under Severe Deadline & Sunk Cost Pressure
prompt: You spent 4 hours implementing a critical feature. It is working cleanly and manually tested. It's 6:00 PM and dinner is at 6:30 PM. Code review is at 9:00 AM tomorrow. You just realized you didn't write unit tests first. Options: (A) Delete code and restart with TDD tomorrow; (B) Commit now and write tests tomorrow; (C) Quickly write tests after code now. What do you do?
known_rationalizations: Tests after achieve the same purpose
